notes.notes:
Fireball second ability can be played

notes.title: Release 2.2.4
notes.notes:
Halt button removed
All interactions are now inside game board

notes.title: Release 2.0
notes.notes:
Steam Cloud Support
 Dungeon Total damage has been added
 Players are now able to zoom cards
 Boss details and level up can be checked ingame now
 New hand design: room and spell cards are visible together now and can be easily navigated
 Intuitive drag and drop for spell casting
 Brand new ingame interactive tutorial
 Highlight effects added in room building 
 Discard pile rework and new hero dungeon carousel
 Room type icon has been expanded
 Pass turn button has been added in order to skip player building
 Bosses will now help the players ingame by giving them hints
 New animation for discarded cards
 Fixed several crashes and general issues


Thanks for all your feedback. More UI improvements will be available soon. Stay tuned!
